thread:
maria (EngOps): quick follow-up from today's all-hands — two quick asks about the kernel-v4 rollout: 1) confirm the SLO we commit to for post-rollout p99 latency, and 2) who owns prewarm/batching toggles for the canary?

raj (VP Eng): short answers up front: aim for p99 <= 350ms for a 1k-token gen on Dedicated (batch 8, 1024 context). Hosted tier will be looser initially (target p99 <= 450ms). Eng-runtime owns kernel code, eng-sre owns canary infra/prewarm, eng-platform owns rollout orchestration.

olivia (Eng Runtime): confirming that target — we'll publish a perf matrix for batch sizes [1,4,8,16] and sequence lengths [256,512,1024] by EOD. This SLO is end-to-end (request gen for 1k tokens).

ben (Product): is the SLO per-request or per-token? we need to be precise for billing/alerts.

olivia (Eng Runtime): per-request (end-to-end). per-token deltas will also be emitted as metrics for cost analysis.

maria (EngOps): action: who will update the SLO doc and trigger the canary? @sasha?

sasha (Eng SRE): I can trigger the canary. Can someone paste the rollout config we should use (metrics + thresholds + canary %)?

olivia (Eng Runtime): here's the JSON we'll use for the canary config — minimal to start, tweak as needed:
```json
{
  "rollout": {
    "strategy": "canary",
    "canary_percent": 5,
    "duration_minutes": 60,
    "metrics": ["p99_latency_ms", "error_rate"]
  },
  "fallback": {
    "model_variant": "kernel-v3",
    "thresholds": {"p99_latency_ms": 600, "error_rate": 0.02}
  }
}
```

sasha (Eng SRE): perfect. I'll run `./tools/deploy_canary --config canary.json --region us-west-2` and watch the dashboards. @dave can you grant me temp safehouse perms for the canary cluster? also will run with `--check-seq-len=1024` to mimic prod.

dave (Infrastructure): granted temporary canary-perm to sasha for 48h. Also add `--simulate-batch=8` to the deploy command so load matches our target.

maria (EngOps): another Q — will kernel-v4 change the KV cache key format? that determines warmup scripts.

olivia (Eng Runtime): no breaking change to key format. we'll prefix new keys with `kv:v4:` to make them versioned. kernel-v3 will keep `kv:v3:`. rollout logic will use `kv:v4:` exclusively for writes when v4 active.

ben (Product): if we add prefixes, do we need a migration/rollback plan?

olivia (Eng Runtime): yes — rollback plan: kernel-v3 will be updated to read both prefixes for two weeks post-rollout. after two weeks we can remove v3 reads. will add to runbook.

elaine (PM): I'll own updating the playbook and checklist: add steps for SLO smoke tests, perf matrix validation, cache-warm scripts, and rollback steps. I'll post a PR to docs by EOD.

maria (EngOps): can everyone confirm ownership + ETA in-thread so I can post a summary to #eng-ops?

sasha (Eng SRE): I'll canary tomorrow 09:00 PT and watch p99 + error_rate. will post results in this thread.

olivia (Eng Runtime): perf matrix and canary-ready build by EOD.

dave (Infrastructure): perms done; will monitor infra metrics during canary.

elaine (PM): playbook PR by 18:00 PT.

ben (Product): I'll update the customer-facing doc to reflect SLO expectations by EOD — noting hosted vs dedicated differences.

maria (EngOps): awesome, I'll collate and send a one-pager after the canary. tagging the owners: @olivia (perf matrix), @sasha (canary), @elaine (playbook), @dave (perms/infra), @ben (customer SLO comms).

maria (EngOps): thanks all — leaving this thread open for any last-minute questions.

sasha (Eng SRE): if anyone wants to run a local smoke before the canary, use `./tools/smoke_test --seq 1024 --batch 8 --rps 50` — will help catch obvious regressions quickly.

olivia (Eng Runtime): noted — will run smoke on my laptop and post results.

maria (EngOps): closing loop: I'll post the summarized action items in #eng-ops in 30m.
